name: edgegrasp_so101_target_cube_grasp_geometry_candidate008_q0p50

geometry_source.derivation: Moving-pad OBB/AABB regenerated from the fixed-SHA gripper frame/joint origins and EdgeGrasp STL-derived distal-pad box. This is static geometry evidence only; runtime contact, lift, and retention remain required.

gazebo_proxy_preflight.source: Pinned URDF primitive boxes plus EdgeGrasp distal-pad proxies transformed into gripper_frame_link; moving pad evaluated at gripper=0.500000 rad.

claim_boundary: This profile is a Gazebo proxy-grasp candidate, not a real-hardware calibration.
The 0.50 rad contact position passes exact oriented-box SAT but must still be confirmed by distal-pad contact plus FJT terminal evidence.
Approach and lift offsets intentionally use different frames and are not interchangeable.
The 30 mm tool +Z plus 80 mm planning-frame +Z far approach and 3 mm descend palm clearance are conservative proxy constraints derived after task039 contacted gripper_link_collision.

The unchanged far approach has candidate003 runtime evidence with the cube present; candidate004 descend must not execute until the cube remains collision-active and only the two dedicated pad links are allowed to contact it.
AABB remains a conservative approach/body-clearance screen; exact OBB SAT is now required for pad contact. Neither proves swept-path safety, dynamics, friction, or contact stability.
Stage commands may use an FK-confirmed pose within 1 mm of the ideal proxy geometry; this tolerance is not a real-hardware calibration.
A valid preflight does not prove IK, collision-free planning, contact, lift, or retention.
